user.title: Connect Polytron Smart AC
user.description: Enter the phone/WhatsApp number registered with your Polytron Smart Home app. An OTP code will be sent via WhatsApp.

otp.title: WhatsApp OTP Verification
otp.description: An OTP code has been sent to WhatsApp number **{phone}**. Enter the 6-digit verification code below.
